title: Vulkan validation messages about mismatched image format related to radiance octmap
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot 4.6-beta 14e840dd752884c4d98cb16f5f6f5fb1604c1e3d

### System information

Android - Samsung Galaxy XR - Qualcomm Adreno (TM) 740

### Issue description

Using the Vulkan mobile renderer on a Samsung Galaxy XR, I'm getting a bunch of vulkan validation messages that all look like this:

```
W 0:00:03:705   _debug_messenger_callback: VALIDATION - Message Id Number: 20145586 | Message Id Name: Undefined-Value-StorageImage-FormatMismatch-ImageView
	vkCmdDispatch(): the storage image descriptor [VkDescriptorSet 0x8630000000863, Set 1, Binding 0, Index 0] is accessed by a OpTypeImage that has a Format operand Rgba16f (equivalent to VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT) which doesn't match the VkImageView 0x7fb00000007fb[Downsampled Radiance Octmap Mip 0  View] format (VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32). Any loads or stores with the variable will produce undefined values to the whole image (not just the texel being accessed).
Spec information at https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/textures.html#textures-format-validation
	Objects - 3
		Object[0] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_PIPELINE, Handle 1278732023104651
		Object[1] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, Handle 2360651464837219
		Object[2] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW, Handle 2246302255548411, Name "Downsampled Radiance Octmap Mip 0  View"
  <C++ Source>  drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:639 @ _debug_messenger_callback()
W 0:00:03:706   _debug_messenger_callback: VALIDATION - Message Id Number: 20145586 | Message Id Name: Undefined-Value-
```

It goes through "Downsampled Radiance Octmap Mip 0" to "... Mip 5", and then has a series that don't specifically mention the radiance octmap like this:

```
W 0:00:03:706   _debug_messenger_callback: VALIDATION - Message Id Number: 20145586 | Message Id Name: Undefined-Value-StorageImage-FormatMismatch-ImageView
	vkCmdDispatch(): the storage image descriptor [VkDescriptorSet 0x86f000000086f, Set 1, Binding 0, Index 0] is accessed by a OpTypeImage that has a Format operand Rgba16f (equivalent to VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT) which doesn't match the VkImageView 0x7f200000007f2 format (VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32). Any loads or stores with the variable will produce undefined values to the whole image (not just the texel being accessed).
Spec information at https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/textures.html#textures-format-validation
	Objects - 3
		Object[0] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_PIPELINE, Handle 1312816883565738
		Object[1] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, Handle 2373845604370543
		Object[2] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW, Handle 2236406650898418
  <C++ Source>  drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:639 @ _debug_messenger_callback()
```

And then it gives up after 10 times.

I assume this originates from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107902

I'm using the Vulkan validation Android binaries version 1.4.335.0 from [here](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-ValidationLayers/releases/tag/vulkan-sdk-1.4.335.0).

### Steps to reproduce

- Make a new project using the Vulkan Mobile renderer
- Add a world environment that includes a procedural sky
- Setup your project to build with Gradle
- Install the Android build templates
- Copy the Vulkan Validation binaries into `android/build/libs/debug/arm64-v8a/`
- Deploy to your Android device with remote debug, and see the messages appear in the editor's errors tab

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The MRP from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113778 also shows this issue - just add the Vulkan validation layers
